copy.title: In QA
copy.headline: How long has each ticket been in QA?
copy.lede: Every open issue a tester has picked up and not yet signed off.
copy.info_panel:
**Long waits here block the release.** A ticket in QA is finished development, so age is testing capacity rather than scope.

- Check the [board](https://github.com/nyulh/ContentHub-Board) before escalating
